features.name: Cat wild
features.description: Graf Cat Marquis III substitutes for symbols.

review:
A fairy tale on 20 lines: brave mice defend their cheese from the sneaky Graf Cat Marquis III, who's the wild.

The signature feature is Wild Frames – every 10th spin, framed positions turn wild, so you always have a little highlight coming up. Medium-high volatility, a 2,820x max and free spins about once every 166 spins. The RTP is below average at 94.96%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
